metric_definitions.cos_pooled_corrected: Legacy unit-direction gain: mean(unit(c) dot g) / sqrt(mean noise-corrected ||g||²). Perfect per-state alignment need not reach 1 when oracle gradient norms vary.
metric_definitions.globally_pooled_cosine_corrected: Ordinary globally pooled cosine: mean(c dot g) / sqrt(mean ||c||² * mean noise-corrected ||g||²). Includes actual critic magnitudes; high-energy states carry greater weight.
metric_definitions.advantage_corr_corrected: Within-state-centered action-value covariance divided by critic SD and noise-corrected oracle SD; pooled over states and sampled fresh actions.
